submittedPrompt: 绘制并排三个独立公开分享错误窄网页，宽比例390、320、320，白底细灰线蓝色品牌，照第二图真实访客宿主。每页顶部蓝书本DooKnow、分享笔记、眼睛只读徽章；底部细线与“由 DooKnow 分享 | 内容随原笔记保存同步更新”。左390和中320正文居中锁图标、标题“分享不存在或已取消”、说明“请向笔记主人获取有效链接。”，没有任何按钮。右320正文居中刷新图标、标题“暂时无法读取分享笔记”、说明精确“连接可能暂时中断，请稍后重新加载。”，可用蓝色“重新加载”。窄文字自然换行、页脚可达，不加密码、登录、续期、私有错误原因、主人导航或额外操作。

sourceContracts.title: 公开分享：不存在/过期/撤销/轮换
permissionRules: Anonymous capability token must remain active and unexpired; no owner session or password gate is required. Public content/resources remain scoped to this shared note.
importantStates: common missing/private-capability failure with lock icon

responsive.supported: Source-defined responsive layout; not runtime-verified in this read-only inventory
responsive.behavior: <=720px article becomes single column and desktop TOC changes to native mobile details; code/tables scroll within content (ShareReader.vue:490). Runtime unverified.

sourceContracts.designReason: A concrete state with its own content, action hierarchy and business state; include in the GPT Image 2 review queue before implementation.
notes: Expired, revoked, rotated, malformed and missing links deliberately use the same 404 public message; do not expose the exact private cause.
No password entry, renewal control or owner status tools.

postprocessing: Original built-in PNG copied byte-for-byte; no pixel edits.

caption.title: Responsive family: ShareReader.vue generic capability404 or temporary-read error card
caption.state: Three independent anonymous ShareReader failure pages390/320/320: A/B common 404 with lock/no retry; C transient non404 with refresh icon/reload action. Never distinguish malformed/revoked/rotated/expired private causes or introduce auth/password gates.

selfInspection.method: Actual native generated PNG viewed against all input images and exact source template/conditional state contracts.
concerns: Static raster is not proof of executed actions, owner/recipient permissions, focus/keyboard, guard enforcement, canvas topology or responsive fit.
Light raster shading and approximate geometry are illustrative; exact source labels and shared flat CSS tokens remain implementation requirements.
Source-derived selected component/state; actual matching runtime capture is unavailable. Supplied actual screenshot is only parent/host reference where present.
